items.says: Move the PROJECTS section above EXPERIENCE so the current ML/LLM direction is established before the older engineering roles.
Add starting and ending pending-case counts to the 68% backlog reduction.
Move 'catching 2 accuracy regressions before release' earlier in the bullet and cut 'the team used to'.
Add the specific capability the per-sensor error budgets enabled the dashboards to do.
Move or reword the load-test clause so it directly states the build-gate function.
Specify what behavior or artifact the automated regression checks validated.
Lead with the automation work instead of 'Maintained the CI pipeline'.
Add a backlog count or dispatch-delay duration before versus after the migration.
Specify what 'working context' measures and the practical consequence the 10K-token limit enabled.
Add deadlock or lost-tool-result rates before and after the change at 50-way fan-out.
Add the most technically meaningful integration or validation step.

Replace the claim that the evaluator 'tracks injected degradation' with wording that says scores were strongly rank-correlated with the imposed perturbation ordering, and specify the two correlated variables.
Replace abstract category labels with specific defects or modules and make the upstream fix active and clear.
